title: Sound effects
summary: Short sound effects shared by every theme, all synthesized in code (generate.py and generate_extra.py: numpy only, no samples), so they can be shared freely. Each file peaks at -3 dBFS; a storyboard sets how loud each one plays.
usage: In a footage storyboard: "sounds": [{"name": "whoosh", "at": 3.8, "gain": -14}]. gain is dB (default -14); the voice is never changed.

items.name: Whoosh
items.description: A filtered-noise sweep that swells and falls away: the standard move for a transition or a layout change.

items.name: Fast whoosh
items.description: A shorter, brighter sweep for whips and punch-ins.

items.name: Low whoosh
items.description: A darker, longer sweep for a card or panel sliding in.

items.name: Swish
items.description: A thin, airy flick for small things arriving: a word, a tab, a line.

items.name: Riser
items.description: Noise and a tone climbing for most of a second: end it on a cut or a hit.

items.name: Pop
items.description: A soft blip that drops in pitch, for a graphic popping in.

items.name: High pop
items.description: The same, smaller and higher: for the second and third things in a row.

items.name: Click
items.description: A short interface click: a button, a toggle, a cursor press.

items.name: Key tick
items.description: One quiet keyboard tick, for a letter typed or a counter stepping.

items.name: Typing run
items.description: Ten irregular key ticks over 0.8 seconds, for a line being typed.

items.name: Shutter
items.description: Two close clicks like a camera shutter: a still, a snapshot, a cut.

items.name: Ding
items.description: A soft small bell: sent, done, confirmed.

items.name: Blip up
items.description: Two rising notes: success, switched on.

items.name: Thump
items.description: A soft low impact with a fast decay, under a slam or a hard cut.

items.name: Impact
items.description: The thump with a short burst of noise on top: the loud hit, once or twice a video.

items.name: Sub drop
items.description: A low sine falling in pitch: weight under a big number or a title landing.

items.name: Siren
items.description: One second of a gentle two-tone wail, mellow rather than piercing.

items.name: Trailer hit
items.description: A long low boom with a crack on top and a dark tail: the one big moment of a video.

items.name: Stamp
items.description: A short dry thud with a slap of noise: a stamp, a label slammed down.

items.name: Punch
items.description: A tight low hit for a word punched in or a hard zoom.

items.name: Notification
items.description: Two soft rising notes: a message arriving.

items.name: Reject
items.description: Two falling buzzy notes: wrong, crossed out, denied.

items.name: Glitch
items.description: A third of a second of gated noise and a stepped tone: a digital stutter.

items.name: Coin
items.description: Two bright notes, the second ringing: money, a point scored.

items.name: Win
items.description: A quick four-note rise: done, success, the payoff.

items.name: Sparkle
items.description: Nine tiny high pings scattered over half a second: a shine on a reveal.

items.name: Water pistol shot
items.description: A toy water pistol firing once: plastic snap, wet squirt, small pop. Not a real gun.

items.name: Water pistol burst
items.description: Three quick water-pistol shots in 0.2 s, for a cartoon shoot-out.

items.name: Cartoon explosion
items.description: A punchy comic explosion: crack, low boom and a rumble with a little debris. A sign blowing apart.
